headline: First Citizens Bank Enters Whole Bank Purchase of United Fidelity Bank
summary: First Citizens Bank announced a whole bank purchase of United Fidelity Bank, FSB, aimed at strengthening its competitive position and supporting sustainable value creation.
why: Bank mergers and acquisitions alter market share, consolidation levels, and strategic footprints within the US regional banking sector.

impacts.name: First Citizens BancShares Inc
impacts.why: First Citizens is acquiring United Fidelity Bank to strengthen its competitive position.
